summary: The candidate fixes duplicate grammar compilation and masking for ordinary tensor parallel constrained decoding without speculative decoding or context parallelism, and its focused tests plus an independent two-process broadcast check pass. It is only a partial implementation of the original unqualified TP contract because speculative TP and context-parallel TP deliberately retain the original per-rank compilation path.

tests.what_was_measured: Prepared recorded base compatibility suite: 92 passed.
On base commit, a simulated non-entry TP rank submitted its own grammar backend lookup and received a Future, reproducing duplicate compilation submission.
Candidate focused suite: 97 passed, including entry-only placeholder behavior, broadcast selection, fallback all-reduce, and no collective for unconstrained batches.

tests.command: independent inline two-process Gloo invocation of Sampler._sync_token_ids_across_tp
tests.what_was_measured: Divergent rank tokens 3 and 9 both became 3 after the candidate's group-root broadcast.

tests.command: independent inline GrammarManager fallback adversarial case
tests.what_was_measured: A non-entry rank made one backend compile/cache lookup and received a Future when entry-only mode was disabled, reproducing the original overhead in the candidate's speculative/context-parallel fallback configurations.
GPU masked argmax [2, 1] matched a separately constructed allowed-token reference [2, 1] on AMD Instinct MI355X; this does not qualify multi-GPU TP serving.

gpu_execution.evidence: A numerical mask/reference check ran on the assigned AMD Instinct MI355X (gfx950), ROCm 7.2, Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2. Only one GPU was available, so the candidate's TP serving path was not executed on GPU.

remaining_counterexamples: TP constrained decoding with speculative decoding: the candidate sets tp_grammar_entry_only false, so every TP rank still compiles the grammar and applies the mask.
TP constrained decoding with active context parallelism: the candidate sets tp_grammar_entry_only false, so every applicable rank still compiles the grammar and applies the mask.
remaining_limitations: Only one GPU was assigned; true TP=2/TP=4 serving and end-to-end CPU-overhead measurement were unavailable.
Speculative TP, context-parallel TP, and DP-attention distributed serving were not executable on the available architecture and remain direct unimplemented portions of the original contract.
The real two-rank collective validation used Gloo on CPU and does not substitute for a multi-GPU ROCm serving run.
No native sources changed, so native rebuild was not applicable. Candidate modules imported from /job/repo/python/sglang at the exact candidate checkout.
